summary: Completed requested Supplier Assessment verification across focused backend suites and read-only superadmin UI flow. Verified Supplier Assessment tab rendering, module toggles/labels/scope controls, registry-label behavior, disabled Documents/Training publishing safeguards, and live supplier my-assessment metadata contract.

minor.issue: Focused suites rely on PYTHONPATH=/app/backend; plain pytest invocation from /app fails collection with ModuleNotFoundError: modules.

action_items: Optional: make backend tests import-stable without manual PYTHONPATH export (e.g., conftest/sys.path or package setup).
Refactor oversized supplier assessment router into smaller modules to improve maintainability and risk isolation.
critical_code_review_comments: File size issue: /app/backend/modules/supplier_assessment/router.py is ~1000 lines (>700 guideline); split by subdomain (suppliers/questionnaires/documents/training/my-assessment/emissions).
Training service has dense one-line compound statements; behavior is currently correct but readability/reviewability is low for future changes.
No calc_engine modifications detected in this run; immutable program/version behavior remained intact in focused tests.
seed_data_creation: None. This run avoided live org config save/mutation and avoided R2 uploads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend check used superadmin credentials, opened /super-admin/org-config, selected an organization from overview, and validated Supplier Assessment tab controls without pressing Save. Backend focused suite command used RUN_LIVE_SUPPLIER_METADATA=1 PYTHONPATH=/app/backend and passed all 21 tests.
rca of the issue: Only unresolved issue is test harness import-path coupling: tests import from top-level 'modules' package, but pytest root at /app does not include /app/backend on sys.path by default. Mitigation: enforce PYTHONPATH in test runner config or add stable path bootstrap in conftest/pytest.ini.
